name: VR ZVER v.2
summary: VR ZVER v.2 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA employs a multi-confirmation entry system with trend filters and momentum validation to reduce false signals. It includes trailing stop functionality and risk management features to protect profits and limit losses.
summary_zh: VR ZVER v.2是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过移动平均线和动量指标的组合来判断市场方向，沿趋势方向入场交易。该EA采用多确认入场系统，结合趋势过滤和动量验证来减少虚假信号，并包含移动止损和风险管理功能来保护利润和限制亏损。
strategy_analysis: VR ZVER v.2的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过多重技术指标确认趋势方向后再入场。入场条件依赖移动平均线的排列方向和动量指标的共振信号，当短期均线上穿长期均线且动量指标确认多头力量时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、移动止损跟踪以及趋势反转信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用基于账户余额百分比的动态手数计算方式，根据市场波动率调整仓位大小。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和回撤保护机制，当账户亏损达到设定阈值时停止交易。该策略的优点是顺势交易胜率较高，但在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: VR ZVER v.2's core strategy is trend following, requiring multiple technical indicator confirmations before entering in the trend direction. Entry conditions rely on moving average alignment and momentum indicator confluence signals, going long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA with momentum confirming bullish strength, and vice versa for shorts. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, trailing stop tracking, and trend reversal signal-triggered position closing. Position sizing uses a dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage, adjusting position size according to market volatility. Money management implements maximum position limits and drawdown protection mechanisms, halting trading when account losses reach a predefined threshold. The strategy's strength lies in higher win rates during trending markets, but it is prone to consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 基于账户余额的风险百分比
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage based on account balance

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description_en: Minimum step to adjust take-profit in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 多指标确认入场减少虚假信号，提高交易胜率
动态仓位管理和回撤保护机制有效控制风险
移动止损跟踪功能锁定浮动利润，避免盈利回吐
顺势交易逻辑清晰，符合市场趋势运行规律
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同市场环境优化设置
pros_en: Multi-indicator confirmation entry reduces false signals and improves win rate
Dynamic position sizing and drawdown protection effectively controls risk
Trailing stop feature locks in floating profits and prevents profit giveback
Trend-following logic is clear and aligns with market trend movement principles
Highly configurable parameters allow users to optimize settings for different market conditions
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中表现不佳，容易产生连续止损
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动切换趋势和震荡模式
固定点数止损未考虑不同货币对的波动率差异
多重确认可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期最佳入场点
过度依赖技术指标，未考虑基本面和市场情绪因素
cons_en: Trend-following strategy performs poorly in ranging markets, prone to consecutive stop-losses
Lacks market regime detection mechanism, cannot automatically switch between trend and range modes
Fixed pip stop-loss doesn't account for volatility differences across currency pairs
Multiple confirmations may cause delayed entries, missing optimal trend initiation points
Over-reliance on technical indicators without considering fundamentals and market sentiment
improvements: 添加市场状态识别模块（如ADX指标），在趋势和震荡行情间自动切换策略
使用ATR动态止损替代固定点数止损，适应不同货币对的波动特性
增加多时间周期分析功能，提高趋势判断的准确性和可靠性
improvements_en: Add market regime detection module (e.g., ADX indicator) to automatically switch strategies between trending and ranging markets
Replace fixed pip stop-loss with ATR-based dynamic stop-loss to adapt to volatility characteristics of different currency pairs
Implement multi-timeframe analysis to improve trend detection accuracy and reliability

risk_points: 缺乏市场状态自动识别，震荡行情中可能持续亏损
固定止损未适配不同品种波动率，可能在高波动品种上频繁止损
回撤保护阈值若设置不当，可能在正常回调时过早停止交易
risk_points_en: Lacks automatic market regime detection, may sustain continuous losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss not adapted to different instrument volatility, may trigger frequently on high-volatility pairs
Drawdown protection threshold if improperly set may halt trading prematurely during normal pullbacks

The EA employs a multi-confirmation entry system with trend filters and momentum validation to reduce false signals. It includes trailing stop functionality and risk management features to protect profits and limit losses.
